review.note: Fresh manual official-upstream review for the single 0.9.1 release on 2026-10-25: hatchling 1.32.4: Reviewed restored build-hook generic compatibility and version-metadata whitespace correction; no custom build hook or bound change required. Official notes: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/. distlib 0.4.4: Reviewed launcher write errors, ScriptMaker shebang detection and archive containment/data_filter changes. Windows launcher execution remains native-platform validation; this release adds no launcher changes. Official notes: https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib. packaging 26.3: Reviewed requirement/marker normalization and exception corrections, VersionRange additions and Python >=3.9. Existing PEP 440/508 parser use remains supported; no replacement parser or tighter bound needed. Official notes: https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. build 1.6.1: Reviewed Windows symlink-probe regression correction and normal sdist-derived build flow; the repository uses the CLI, not the removed BuildBackendException exc_info API. Official notes: https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. mypy 2.4.0: Reviewed native parser default, Python 3.15 support, old for/with type-comment limitation and removal of accelerated macOS x86_64 wheels. Current strict checks passed on this Apple Silicon Python 3.14 environment without config relaxation. Official notes: https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest 9.1.1: Reviewed RaisesGroup, indirect fixture parametrization, type-checking and initial conftest fixes. Existing source-authoritative entry and 55 focused cases passed. Official notes: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest-xdist 3.8.0: Reviewed loadscope ordering options and prior main-thread worker/bootstrap behavior. Python >=3.9 permits 3.14; no new explicit Python 3.14 classifier is claimed. No worker policy changes in this task. Official notes: https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html. ruff 0.17.2: Reviewed starred-type-variable syntax and false-positive corrections and unsafe fix classification. Existing formatter/lint configuration passed without relaxation. Official notes: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.2. markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0: Reviewed dependency update including markdownlint. Exact tag package.json requires Node >=22; local Node 24 and markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0 passed the existing Markdown gate. Official notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md. The canonical generator freshly queries every direct runtime/build/dev Python requirement and Node requirement; its latest versions must match this reviewed set, all declared bounds must admit those versions, and current package metadata must permit Python 3.14. No newest stable dependency is excluded and no identified compatibility reason requires a new upper bound. This patch changes only reviewer reading/continuation instructions and their fail-closed regression; dependency bounds and V3 evidence format remain unchanged. Exact-candidate full review/gate and native Windows execution are separate evidence, not implied by these notes or the 55 focused checks.
